newsitem.title: USA: Triangle says it will buy 10 offices.
newsitem.headline: Triangle says it will buy 10 offices.

text.p: Triangle Bank said Wednesday it signed an agreement to buy the deposits and loans of 10 offices of United Carolina Bank and Branch Banking & Trust Co.
Triangle said the agreement calls for it to assume about $215 million in core deposits and purchase about $71 million in loans.
Triangle said the offices are located in the eastern and south central North Carolina communities of Fairmont, Fremont, Goldsboro, Hamlet, Lumberton, Plymouth, Roper, Sanford and Wallace.
The purchase of these offices is expected to be complete in mid-August, Triangle said.
This acquisition, Triangle said, will represent a move, primarily, into new markets for Triangle, which currently operates 46 offices in central and eastern North Carolina.
